text:
olivia-cs: Heads-up: Customer 'Arcadia' is blocked on onboarding. During CI warmup their RN app is getting 429s on /v1/preflight. Cutover scheduled for 2026-04-02. They need a fast mitigation.
jack-eng: Can you paste the exact error and any client headers?
olivia-cs: Paste from their logs: 
```
POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/preflight
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral-token>
X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1
Response: 429 {"error":"rate_limit", "retry_after":2}
```
mateo-cs: They reported spinning 18 parallel warmup jobs in CI and seeing occasional 401s when ephemeral tokens rotate at the same time.
dev-rel: Likely preflight fanout + simultaneous refreshes exhausting their tenant bucket. Immediate customer advice: 1) set region explicitly in SDK init, 2) add jitter to token refresh, 3) cap warmup concurrency to <=5.
jack-eng: Infra can do a short-term tenant cap bump or accept X-Redwood-Region header as fallback for preflight endpoints. Which does customer prefer?
olivia-cs: They want ops bump for the cutover window. Tenant id = t-arcadia-9 and traceroute IPs = 34.83.12.45, 35.204.4.10.
ops-bot: INC-9620 created: request temporary preflight cap bump for t-arcadia-9 until 2026-04-03T08:00:00Z. Tagged infra + edge.
dev-rel: Small RN snippet to send them: 
```js
Redwood.init({
  apiKey: '__ephemeral__',
  region: 'eu-west-1',
  preflight: { maxConcurrency: 4 },
  auth: { refreshJitterMs: 250 }
});
```
mateo-cs: I sent snippet + asked them to throttle CI warmups from 18->4 and upgrade to rn-mobile-sdk v1.0.0 which includes jittered refresh. Customer agreed to change their CI and accept temporary bump.
jack-eng: Ops confirmed INC-9620 applied. Please monitor token refresh errors and preflight metrics for t-arcadia-9 for next 24h.
olivia-cs: Thanks all. I’ll follow up after cutover and post a short onboarding playbook note about region pinning and warmup best practices.
